text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated even in months when I made no trades, so I should not react to every monthly change.","Selling Stocks B, C and E at losses did not reliably protect my account; I should decide based on risk, prospects and my overall plan, not just my purchase price or recent losses.","Because these savings support my retirement, I should trade deliberately, preserve enough cash for flexibility and avoid risks that could cause losses I cannot comfortably bear."]}
